title: One entity within an existing (or standalone) feature

name.description: Entity name, lower kebab-case; for a domain module, the module name (e.g. todos, reward-claims). Its files are named after it.

feature.description: Existing feature (src/features/{feature}) this entity's files land under. Defaults to the entity's own kebab-case name (a standalone feature).

remote.description: Emit a Supabase migration stub (schema layer) and a Supabase-backed repository (repository layer) instead of a Dexie table and repository.

layer.description: Emit only one core.yaml layer's files: "schema" the Zod schema, its spec, and the table file plus the src/db/schema.ts append (or, with --remote, the supabase/migrations stub); "repository" the fixture, repository, and repository spec. Omit to emit both in one run.
